description: Use when an agent needs a wallet risk check before sending funds to a crypto address. Screens the address against the OFAC sanctions list and reads its on-chain footprint on Base (tx count, balance, contract or not; flags an empty, disposable address), with a human-vouch overlay. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), sanctioned flag, on_chain activity, red_flags and a signed attestation. Input: ?address=0x... Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.
name: dyoe_wallet
title: DYOE Wallet Screening ($0.05)
